item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - The Electric Company (2009 series) [AMZN(Amazon Prime Video) or YouTube Rip]
item.description:
The full series of The Electric Company (2009) was uploaded to Internet Archive: , and most of the episodes on there were ripped from PBS Learning Media, expect for the episodes 'Franscent', which was ripped from Amazon Prime Video, and 'Prankster Holiday', which was ripped from Dailymotion, and my focus for this thread is the original versions of 7 episodes from the series:
  • Lost and Spaced
  • War of the Words
  • Limerick-Off
  • Out To Launch
  • Friends or Aunts
  • Oh Danny Boy
  • Madame President
I've been looking for the original versions of these episodes(which in 2012 had been re-edited to add "Reverse-a-Balls" to tie in to the animated segments at the end of the episode and added, replaced and removed certain skits in-between the episode[like the added 'Electric Sound Off' skits done in the same style as the Popsicle Stick Recaps] and thus, those versions are used on the PBS Learning Media website, though the Internet Archive upload doesn't have the re-edited version of 'Franscent'[I think, can't remember, so I think the re-edited version of that episode is lost media, because the theme song to the animated segment at the end of the re-edited episodes said that 'Francine has 8 machines'{machines meaning Reverse-A-Ball machines} and only 7/8 of those episodes are on that upload] since that episode was not on PBS Learning Media), and I found the original versions of the above episodes on YouTube and Amazon Prime Video but I don't have money on both of my accounts and I also can't rip them with the tools I have. Can someone please rip the whole series from either YouTube or Amazon Prime video for me?
